workflows.description: Trace signature verification, algorithm selection and claim checks, or the delegation flow’s redirect and state handling, in the supplied revision
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Decode and re-encode a token you hold using a local library
prerequisites: Bounded execution in your own sandbox scratch; network egress is available and any download or install must be receipted.

workflows.description: Compare acceptance of a structurally changed token or flow step for principals you register yourself; local HTTP alone is not identity
prerequisites: An identity you obtain yourself: register a disposable account through the target's own signup flow, keep each named principal's cookies in its own jar, or use a sealed secret if one exists.
